_CORRECTION.what_this_record_is_not: THIS IS NOT EVIDENCE THAT EGCH'S FILINGS CARRY NO CAPITAL NOTE. Every 'no note found' line below was produced by a run that read ARABIC SCANS WITH THE ENGLISH MODEL. EGCH files its annual report in Arabic; tesseract's Arabic model reads those same scans cleanly — verified on page 20 of the FY2015-16 report, which came back as legible accounting-policy prose. The finding here is about the reader, not the document.
_CORRECTION.what_happened_next: The run was repeated with the Arabic model and a two-pass find-then-read scheme. It was still running after 80 minutes without completing a single document — tesseract's Arabic model is multi-threaded and two such runs saturated all four cores — and it was STOPPED deliberately rather than left to consume the machine: the share counts it would produce feed [R-VCAL-01]'s series (a), which the same day's census showed is blocked on capital expenditure regardless, so they unblock nothing today.
_CORRECTION.when_it_is_wanted: At EGCH's next walk-forward run, where [R-FCAL-01 AMENDED] now REQUIRES the share count as part of the valuation-input block. Run it with OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1 so the pages do not thrash, and narrow the page window: the capital note sits in the notes, not in the last few pages.
_CORRECTION.kept_rather_than_deleted: so that nobody re-runs the English model on Arabic scans and reaches the same wrong conclusion a second time.
